brief:
Palestinians approaching ballot boxes encounter political calculations that redirect them to waiting rooms, Shehab Wire reported. The stated justifications shift, but the outcome remains constant: citizens are denied the right to choose their representatives, and national institutions remain captive to individuals and partisan interests.

The practice reflects a pattern where electoral participation is curtailed through various pretexts, effectively insulating Palestinian leadership structures from democratic accountability to the public.

title: Palestinian Authority blocks citizens from voting booths
